title: Programmatic SEO: building pages at scale that rank without thin content
summary: Corey's playbook for creating SEO pages at scale from templates and data. It covers picking one of 12 page patterns, ranking data by defensibility, URL and internal linking structure, indexation control, and the mistakes that trigger thin-content penalties.

principles.text: Every programmatic page needs value unique to that page, not just swapped variables.
principles.quote: Every page must provide value specific to that page

principles.text: Proprietary data beats public data. Rank data sources by how defensible they are.
principles.quote:
Proprietary (you created it)
2. Product-derived (from your users)
3. User-generated (your community)
4. Licensed (exclusive access)
5. Public (anyone can use—weakest)

principles.text: Put pages in subfolders, not subdomains, to consolidate domain authority.
principles.quote: Use subfolders, not subdomains** — subfolders consolidate domain authority while subdomains split it

principles.text: Fewer great pages beat masses of thin ones; don't generate pages with no search demand.
principles.quote: Better to have 100 great pages than 10,000 thin ones.

principles.text: Layer multiple playbooks for more specific, higher-intent page targets.
principles.quote: You can layer multiple playbooks (e.g., "Best coworking spaces in San Diego").

principles.text: Control indexation: prioritize high-volume patterns, noindex thin variations, split sitemaps by page type.
principles.quote:
Prioritize high-volume patterns
- Noindex very thin variations
- Manage crawl budget thoughtfully
- Separate sitemaps by page type
